LightningComponentBundle.description: Line chart of daily total calorie consumption for the active Nutrition Profile, with a 2000 kcal reference line. Auto-refreshes when a meal is logged.

property.name: daysToShow
property.label: Days to show
property.description: Number of recent days (including today) to plot on the x-axis.

property.name: theme
property.label: Theme
property.description: Dark = SLDS navy (matches a dark dashboard); Light = white.

property.name: chartTitle
property.label: Chart title
property.description: Heading above the chart, personalised with the active profile's first name. Leave blank to hide.
